instruction.text: The pupils in Class 1A are sharing their family traditions. Fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: Helena: My favourite day is Christmas Eve. We always ((++play cook)) boardgames with the whole family.
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '+1st'> My favourite day is Christmas Eve. We always play boardgames with the whole family.</prosody>

atoms.b: Vreni: On New Year’s Eve, we always have a big supper with our grandmother, and we are allowed to go to bed ((++late early)).
atoms.sound: ssml: On New Year’s Eve, we always have a big supper with our grandmother, and we are allowed to go to bed late

atoms.b: Levi: I like my birthday. It is one of the few ((++days months)) of the year when all of my family is together.
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '+4st'>I like my birthday. It is one of the few days of the year when all of my family is together.</prosody><break time='1000ms'/>

atoms.b: Sam: On the anniversary of my aunt’s death, we always cook her ((++favourite_meal favourite_game)) and watch old videos. I think it’s very sweet.
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '+1st'>On the anniversary of my aunt’s death, we always cook her favourite meal and watch old videos. I think it’s very sweet.</prosody>

atoms.b: Fatima: My favourite is Bonfire night! We always go to the local fireworks display and have ((++toffee_apples salad)).
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '+4st'>My favourite is Bonfire night! We always go to the local fireworks display and have toffee apples.</prosody>

atoms.b: Tim: I ((++like hate)) Easter the best. Our family goes on a walk to see the baby lambs.
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '+0.5st'>I like Easter the best. Our family goes on a walk to see the baby lambs.</prosody>

instruction.text: Pin the different family traditions to the board.

sound.end: Some traditions take place on holidays.
Families celebrate holidays in different ways.
For some celebrations, the whole family comes together.
On important holidays, there is often a traditional meal.
